articles.title: Trump administration to name Nvidia, OpenAI and several others as AI national champions
articles.snippet: The Wall Street Journal reported that the move aims to help the firms expand overseas and compete with global rivals, though nothing has been confirmed.

articles.title: Clarity Act Defeat ‘Failure of American Leadership’: Trump’s Former Crypto Chief
articles.snippet: Former White House crypto chief Patrick Witt said the Clarity Act "lost against the clock," and regulators will now set the rules.

articles.title: Trump Backs Jensen Huang’s Return to Nvidia as Sam Altman Says 'Heroes Have Flaws'
articles.snippet: Trump would welcome Nvidia’s co-founder back. Altman, who survived his own CEO ouster, sympathizes but stops short of endorsing Huang’s comeback.

articles.title: Trump’s First Democratic Picks for SEC and CFTC Could Reshape Crypto’s Regulators
articles.snippet: The bipartisan slate—two Republicans and two Democrats, Trump’s first Democratic picks for either agency—would refill commissions that have driven crypto policy since the Clarity Act’s collapse.
